title: Figure 11: contemporary primary flight display linked to legacy analog gauges
description: Composite image of a glass-cockpit primary flight display (artificial horizon, airspeed tape, altitude tape, heading, MACH/ALT CRZ/NAV modes) surrounded by photos of older mechanical instruments—attitude indicator, airspeed indicator, altimeter, vertical speed and compass—with red arrows linking each to its PFD counterpart. Captioned "Figure 11. Contemporary Primary Flight Display," sourced from freshgasflow.com. The text discusses adapting such displays for six-degree-of-freedom breakthrough-era craft.
